commercial.meta: US enterprise insurance platform | English-speaking stakeholder collaboration

paragraphs: Progressed from junior development to senior engineering responsibilities and then business and systems analysis on an enterprise insurance platform.
Redesigned JSON data exchange across the backend, frontend, and Azure Functions, reducing loading time for complex insurance policies from approximately 20 to 5 seconds.
Contributed to legacy-system decomposition into microservices: dependency analysis, service boundaries, contract discussions, and migration planning.
Designed REST APIs and ensured backward compatibility between projects developed by different teams.
Supported the team lead in architectural discussions, task decomposition, and sprint planning; conducted code reviews and mentored junior developers.
Collaborated regularly with US-based product managers and business stakeholders on requirements, delivery planning, and cross-team technical decisions. Working language — English.
Worked directly with US business stakeholders to clarify needs, discuss solution constraints and align delivery plans for an enterprise insurance platform. Working language: English.
Turned ambiguous requests into functional and non-functional requirements, clarified dependencies and supported developers throughout implementation.
Contributed to legacy-system decomposition into microservices, defining service boundaries and API contracts while preserving compatibility across teams.
